Name: Continue
Description: The server has received the request headers and the client should proceed to send the request body.

Name: Switching Protocols
Description: The requester has asked the server to switch protocols and the server has agreed to do so.

Name: Processing
Description: The server has received and is processing the request, but no response is available yet.

Name: Early Hints
Description: Used to return some response headers before final HTTP message.

Name: OK
Description: Standard response for successful HTTP requests.

Name: Created
Description: The request has been fulfilled, resulting in the creation of a new resource.

Name: Accepted
Description: The request has been accepted for processing, but the processing has not been completed.

Name: Non-Authoritative Information
Description: The server is a transforming proxy that received a 200 OK from its origin, but is returning a modified version.

Name: No Content
Description: The server successfully processed the request, but is not returning any content.

Name: Reset Content
Description: The server successfully processed the request and requires that the requester reset the document view.

Name: Partial Content
Description: The server is delivering only part of the resource due to a range header sent by the client.

Name: Multi-Status (WebDAV)
Description: The message body is an XML message and can contain a number of separate response codes.

Name: Already Reported (WebDAV)
Description: The members of a DAV binding have already been enumerated in a preceding part of the multistatus response.

Name: IM Used
Description: The server has fulfilled a request for the resource using instance-manipulations.

Name: Multiple Choices
Description: Indicates multiple options for the resource from which the client may choose.

Name: Moved Permanently
Description: This and all future requests should be directed to the given URI.

Name: Found
Description: The resource resides temporarily under a different URI.

Name: See Other
Description: The response to the request can be found under another URI using a GET method.

Name: Not Modified
Description: Indicates that the resource has not been modified since the version specified by the request headers.

Name: Use Proxy
Description: The requested resource is available only through a proxy, the address for which is provided in the response.

Name: Switch Proxy
Description: No longer used. Originally meant that subsequent requests should use the specified proxy.

Name: Temporary Redirect
Description: The resource resides temporarily under a different URI and the client must not change the request method.

Name: Permanent Redirect
Description: The resource is now permanently located at another URI, using the same method.

Name: Bad Request
Description: The server cannot or will not process the request due to a client error.

Name: Unauthorized
Description: The request requires user authentication or invalid credentials were provided.

Name: Payment Required
Description: Reserved for future use.

Name: Forbidden
Description: The server refuses to fulfill the request, despite knowing who the client is.

Name: Not Found
Description: The requested resource could not be found on the server.

Name: Method Not Allowed
Description: A request method is not supported for the requested resource.

Name: Not Acceptable
Description: The requested resource can only generate content not matching the Accept headers.

Name: Proxy Authentication Required
Description: The client must first authenticate itself with the proxy.

Name: Request Timeout
Description: The server timed out waiting for the request.

Name: Conflict
Description: Indicates a conflict in the current state of the resource.

Name: Gone
Description: Indicates that the resource requested is permanently gone and will not return.

Name: Length Required
Description: The request did not specify the length of its content.

Name: Precondition Failed
Description: The server does not meet one of the preconditions specified by the client.

Name: Payload Too Large
Description: The request is larger than the server is willing or able to process.

Name: URI Too Long
Description: The URI provided was too long for the server to process.

Name: Unsupported Media Type
Description: The request entity has a media type which the server does not support.

Name: Range Not Satisfiable
Description: The client asked for a portion of the file, but the server cannot supply that portion.

Name: Expectation Failed
Description: The server cannot meet the requirements of the Expect request-header field.

Name: I'm a teapot
Description: The server refuses to brew coffee because it is, permanently, a teapot.

Name: Misdirected Request
Description: The request was directed at a server that is not able to produce a response.

Name: Unprocessable Entity (WebDAV)
Description: The request was well-formed but unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

Name: Locked (WebDAV)
Description: The resource that is being accessed is locked.

Name: Failed Dependency (WebDAV)
Description: The request failed due to failure of a previous request.

Name: Too Early
Description: Indicates that the server is unwilling to risk processing a replayed request.

Name: Upgrade Required
Description: The client should switch to a different protocol such as TLS/1.0.

Name: Precondition Required
Description: The origin server requires the request to be conditional.

Name: Too Many Requests
Description: The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time (rate limiting).

Name: Request Header Fields Too Large
Description: The server is unwilling to process the request because its header fields are too large.

Name: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
Description: A server operator has received a legal demand to deny access to a resource.

Name: Internal Server Error
Description: A generic error message when an unexpected server-side condition was encountered.

Name: Not Implemented
Description: The server either does not recognize the request method, or lacks the ability to fulfill it.

Name: Bad Gateway
Description: The server acting as a gateway received an invalid response from the upstream server.

Name: Service Unavailable
Description: The server is currently unavailable (overloaded or down for maintenance).

Name: Gateway Timeout
Description: The server acting as a gateway did not receive a timely response from the upstream server.

Name: HTTP Version Not Supported
Description: The server does not support the HTTP protocol version used in the request.

Name: Variant Also Negotiates
Description: Transparent content negotiation for the request results in a circular reference.

Name: Insufficient Storage (WebDAV)
Description: The server is unable to store the representation needed to complete the request.

Name: Loop Detected (WebDAV)
Description: The server detected an infinite loop while processing the request.

Name: Not Extended
Description: Further extensions to the request are required for the server to fulfill it.

Name: Network Authentication Required
Description: The client needs to authenticate to gain network access.
